description.en: Generic dry-state endorheic playa basin geological form informed by NPS White Sands dry-playa photo and primary closed-basin explanation. Not exact White Sands DEM, named modern lake outline, measured locality or geological period. Nominal600x480x20m terrain module with broad floor at about3m above lower cut, rim approximately10-18m, chosen illustrative contour for512px readability. Playas can contain shallow ephemeral water; this asset represents dry state, not assertion always dry. No crater-like high rim or through river.
